source: Hand-driven through the real OIDC client (auth_renaper.py's _claims_reales/_post_form) against an in-process fake upstream — id.argentina.gob.ar is not reachable/credentialed from this environment (the RENAPER/Mi Argentina contract described in auth_renaper.py's module docstring hadn't shipped test credentials as of this recording). Token+userinfo response shapes match the standard OIDC authorization-code exchange auth_renaper.py's own code reads (access_token/id_token, then the userinfo claims _extraer_datos parses). Produced by running the real client through this cassette engine's own recorder (tests/cassettes/_vcr.py, TURNOS_CASSETTE_MODE=record), then PII-scrubbed the same way a live recording would be — though the identity fed in is auth_renaper.py's OWN _claims_fake() placeholder persona ('Prueba Renaper', DNI 99000001, the synthetic test-identity range renaper.py's stub provider already seeds), never a real citizen. Re-record against the real IDP (scripts/record_cassette.py --connector renaper --scenario login_callback_ok) once RENAPER test credentials exist, and diff-review before committing, per Area 3's doctrine.
